name: Culture & history
title: Culture and history holidays
intro: Old towns, ancient ruins, temples and museums. Here's where to go for a holiday full of history and culture, and the best time to visit each.

faqs.question: Where is best for history on holiday?
faqs.answer: Rome, Kraków, Cusco, Jordan and Crete are packed with history, from ancient ruins to old towns you can wander for days.

faqs.question: Where is good for culture in winter?
faqs.answer: Oman, Kerala, Sri Lanka, Oaxaca and Luang Prabang are all at their best between December and February, when it's dry and not too hot.

faqs.question: Are culture holidays good with children?
faqs.answer: They can be. Pick places with plenty to do outdoors as well as indoors, keep museum visits short, and leave time for a swim or a playground.
